name: crux
title: Crux
description: A climbing and bouldering gym theme on anthracite wall paint drilled with T-nuts, where every class on the timetable is a white route tag with a band of hold-colour tape for its day, the time and class in black marker capitals and the level in a ruled grade box.

tokens.--font-marker: condensed capitals: the site title, the menu, headings, day names, and the time, class and level written on each route tag
tokens.--font-mono: printed parts: the teacher line and the small Level label on a tag, the This week label, disciplines, dates, table headings and code
tokens.--font-body: running text, the intro line under a title, and the first-visit note
tokens.--text-s: small text: teacher lines, disciplines, dates, table headings, the footer
tokens.--text-m: base text size, class names on the tags, menu links
tokens.--text-l: the site title, day names, the intro line under a title, third-level headings
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text and instructor names in the list
tokens.--text-time: the time on each route tag, the largest type on the timetable
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the condensed capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the wall: page background (anthracite paint; birch ply in the light scheme)
tokens.--color-tnut: the T-nut holes drilled in a staggered grid across the wall
tokens.--color-panel: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-text: chalk ink on the wall: text, headings, day names, the outline of the Try a class and page buttons, the rule under table headings, and the dashed cut edge of a table that scrolls sideways
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the wall: menu links, intro lines, the This week label, disciplines, dates, the No classes note and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: violet: links, the marker under the current menu item, the focus ring, the Today flag and the Try a class button when hovered
tokens.--color-on-accent: text on the violet hover fill of the Try a class button, and selected text
tokens.--color-rule: thin lines on the wall: under the masthead, between days, above each instructor, table rows, the outline of an empty day
tokens.--color-tag: the white laminate of the route tags (the same in both schemes)
tokens.--color-tag-edge: the cut edge of a tag and the frame of instructor photos (shows on birch ply; blends on the dark wall)
tokens.--color-marker: black marker on the tags: time, class name, level and the grade box around it
tokens.--color-tag-print: the grey printed parts of a tag: the teacher line and the Level label
tokens.--tape-1: violet tape: Monday's tags (then every sixth day), the first instructor's tab, and the strips beside the site title, the first-visit note and quotes
tokens.--tape-2: yellow tape: the second day's tags and instructor tab
tokens.--tape-3: green tape: the third day's tags and instructor tab
tokens.--tape-4: orange tape: the fourth day's tags and instructor tab
tokens.--tape-5: blue tape: the fifth day's tags and instructor tab
tokens.--tape-6: red tape: the sixth day's tags and instructor tab
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the masthead, the page and the footer
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right edges of the page
tokens.--day-col: width of the column of day names beside the tags on wider screens
tokens.--tag-min: narrowest a route tag may be before a row holds one fewer tag
tokens.--tnut-pitch: distance between T-nut holes on the wall
tokens.--border: width of thin lines and of a tag's edge
tokens.--border-strong: width of the grade box, button outlines and the dashed empty-day outline
tokens.--tap: minimum touch height of menu links and buttons
